lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a minimum of seven distinct vertical columns. Centroids within the central columns show approximately equidistant vertical spacing, forming a predictable 2D grid relative to the fish's longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a rigid lattice structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally along the superior lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Observed transition from a structured grid of large blobs on the flank to a dense, stochastic clustering of significantly smaller, low-contrast points in the cephalic region posterior to the eye.
